observed_failure: MIM HTTP API was unreachable externally at http://192.168.1.120:8000 and locally on the MIM host at http://127.0.0.1:8000.
evidence: TOD remote-mode ping-mim returned: Unable to connect to the remote server.
SSH-local urllib checks on MIM host returned connection refused for 127.0.0.1:8000/health and /status.
SSH and SFTP to /home/testpilot/mim/runtime/shared succeeded, so the host is reachable but the API service is not listening.
root_cause_hypothesis: The MIM API/runtime service is stopped, crashed, bound to a different port, or blocked by service startup failure.
bounded_fix_objective: Restore or restart the MIM API/runtime service, then consume MIM_LAB_AWARENESS_OBJECTIVE.latest.json and execute the first sensor inventory task.
validation_plan: From MIM host, curl or urllib http://127.0.0.1:8000/health returns HTTP 200 or structured health JSON.
From TOD host, ping-mim in remote mode succeeds against http://192.168.1.120:8000.
MIM publishes MIM_LAB_AWARENESS_STATUS.latest.json acknowledging the lab-awareness objective.
MIM publishes the first sensor inventory artifact or a precise blocked reason.
recurrence_guard: When a MIM-owned objective is published but the API is down, MIM must create a service-restore learning objective and avoid pretending the objective is executing until service health is proven.
